wikipedia.extract: Nyctiprogne is a genus of small South American nightjars in the nightjar family Caprimulgidae. These are small sexually monomorphic nightjars with short bills, semi‐concealed nostrils, and unmarked wings.
wikipedia.title: Nyctiprogne

commonNames.name: Gorontalo Macaque
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Gorontalo macaque or Dumoga-bone macaque (Macaca nigrescens) is a species of primate in the family Cercopithecidae. It is endemic to the island of Sulawesi in Indonesia.
wikipedia.title: Gorontalo macaque

wikipedia.extract: Cepphus is a genus of seabirds in the auk family also referred to as guillemots by association with the related genus Uria, or tysties, from the Old Norse name for C. grylle.
wikipedia.title: Cepphus

wikipedia.extract: The genus Syrmaticus contains the five species of long-tailed pheasants. The males have short spurs and usually red facial wattles, but otherwise differ wildly in appearance.
wikipedia.title: Syrmaticus

wikipedia.extract: Megaladapis, informally known as the koala lemur, is an extinct genus of lemurs belonging to the family Megaladapidae, consisting of three species that once inhabited the island of Madagascar. The largest measured between 1.3 to 1.5 m (4 to 5 ft) in length.
wikipedia.title: Megaladapis

wikipedia.extract: The Shan State langur (Trachypithecus phayrei shanicus) is a subspecies of primate in the family Cercopithecidae. It is found in eastern Myanmar and southwest China.
wikipedia.title: Shan State langur

wikipedia.extract: Merulaxis or bristlefronts, is a genus of bird in the family Rhinocryptidae.
wikipedia.title: Merulaxis

wikipedia.extract: Cercococcyx is a genus of cuckoos in the family Cuculidae, known as the long-tailed cuckoos.
wikipedia.title: Cercococcyx

commonNames.name: Brown-headed Spider Monkey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

commonNames.name: Black-headed Spider Monkey; Colombian Black Spider Monkey (rufiventris)

wikipedia.extract: The black-headed spider monkey (Ateles fusciceps) is a species of spider monkey from Central and South America, specifically Colombia, Ecuador, and Panama. Although primatologists such as Colin Groves (1989) follow Kellogg and Goldman (1944) in treating A. fusciceps as a separate species, other authors, including Froelich (1991), Collins and Dubach (2001) and Nieves (2005) treat it as a subspecies of Geoffroy's spider monkey.
wikipedia.title: Black-headed spider monkey

commonNames.name: Broad-billed Roller
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The broad-billed roller (Eurystomus glaucurus) is a member of the roller family of birds which breeds across tropical Africa and Madagascar in all but the driest regions. It is a wet season breeder, which migrates from the northern and southern areas of its range towards the moister equatorial belt in the dry season.
wikipedia.title: Broad-billed roller

wikipedia.extract: Malurus is a genus of passerine birds in the Australasian wren family, Maluridae.
wikipedia.title: Malurus

wikipedia.extract: The bat hawk (Macheiramphus alcinus) is a raptor found in sub-Saharan Africa and south Asia to New Guinea. It is named for its diet, which consists mainly of bats.
wikipedia.title: Bat hawk

commonNames.name: Arunachal Macaque
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

gbif.scientificName: Macaca munzala Sinha, Datta, Madhusudan & Mishra, 2005

wikipedia.extract: The Arunachal macaque (Macaca munzala) is a macaque native to Eastern Himalayas of Bhutan, China and India. It is listed as Endangered on the IUCN Red List.
wikipedia.title: Arunachal macaque

commonNames.name: Black-footed Gray Langur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The black-footed gray langur (Semnopithecus hypoleucos) is an Old World monkey, one of the species of langurs. Found in southern India, this, like other gray langurs, is a leaf-eating monkey.
wikipedia.title: Black-footed gray langur

wikipedia.extract: Querandiornis romani was a species of Tinamid bird that lived during the Pleistocene.
wikipedia.title: Querandiornis
